request.prompt: Extract the nutrition / supplement facts table from this photo, following the instructions in the system prompt.
request.system_prompt:
Context: this image is the nutrition / supplement facts panel for the product 'organic clear fiber prebiotic fiber' by 'renewlife'. Use that to disambiguate column headers (e.g. age-band %DV columns) when reading the table.

You extract the nutrition / supplement facts table from a product photo for a deterministic comparison task. Return a JSON object with one key, `"rows"`, whose value is an array of arrays of strings. Each inner array is one row of the table, in top-to-bottom order. Within a row, cells go left-to-right in the column order printed on the panel; do not reorder or merge columns. Header rows (e.g. `Amount per serving`, age-band columns) are rows too — emit them in source order so column meaning is preserved. Use an empty string `""` for cells the panel leaves blank. Use `"▮"` for cells whose text is occluded, glared, cut off, or otherwise unreadable. Lower-case all text; preserve punctuation (parentheses, percent signs, decimal points). Do not invent values or fill in nutrients that are not visible. Return JSON only, no prose.

response.text: {"rows": [["supplement facts"], ["serving size: approx. 1 scoop (6.6 g)"], ["servings per container about 30"], ["amount per serving", "", "%daily value"], ["calories", "15", ""], ["total carbohydrate", "6 g", "2%***"], ["dietary fiber", "6 g", "21%***"], ["soluble fiber", "6 g", "**"], ["organic resistant tapioca dextrin", "6.6 g", "**"], ["**daily value not established."], ["***percent daily values are based on a 2,000 calorie diet."]]}
